_note: the dialectic list — hero ⟷ anti-hero per map; built in conversation (tools/heroes.py). HERO = what the walk champions; ANTI = what the turn raises against it; TENSION = the map's dialectic in one line.

Point_One.hero: the point — the first mark placed
Point_One.anti: the frame-counter — the loop already running
Point_One.tension: individuation ⟷ arriving late into someone else's clock (thrownness)

Point_Lines.hero: Klee's walking line — drawing as gesture and time
Point_Lines.anti: Le Corbusier's Modulor — the body made a standard ruler
Point_Lines.tension: the line as walk ⟷ the line as measure (pleasure that is also violence)

Point_Trace.anti: the line — that compresses it to two endpoints
Point_Trace.tension: what the body leaves ⟷ what the symbol keeps

Point_Line_Grid.tension: the fluid self ⟷ the shareable record (the snap)

Point_Triangle_Context.hero: the rigid triangle — no deformation without rupture
Point_Triangle_Context.anti: the flexible quad — that bends rather than break

Primitives_Polythedra.anti: becoming_catalyst — the primitive that acts back on you
Primitives_Polythedra.tension: the inert building block ⟷ the block that changes the knower

Point_Animatedcube.hero: the cube — the first sealed interior
Point_Animatedcube.anti: the corner-drag — stability revealed as convention
Point_Animatedcube.tension: enclosure as achievement ⟷ enclosure as confinement

Primitives_Ignorance.hero: the Platonic solid — the 'given' perfect form
Primitives_Ignorance.anti: the resolution dial (sphere low/mid/high), the unnameable roughrock
Primitives_Ignorance.tension: the primitive as given ⟷ the primitive as a move in a language game (Wittgenstein)

Primitives_Portals.anti: Achilles & the tortoise — Zeno, never arriving
Primitives_Portals.tension: the continuum ⟷ the discrete that cannot reach it (π, the uncomputable)

Primitives_Melencolia.anti: Dürer's angel — immobilized by knowing (code_display at exhaustion)
Primitives_Melencolia.tension: mastery ⟷ the melancholy of finitude (completion as mourning)

Array_Patterns.hero: the tile — one cell that becomes a floor
Array_Patterns.anti: the loom / Jacquard's card — the array as inherited labor and imposition
Array_Patterns.tension: carpet ⟷ algorithm (the handmade is already computation)

Tutorial_Single.hero: the single cube — index zero, the atom
Tutorial_Single.anti: its own smallness — one is not yet a pattern
Tutorial_Single.tension: interaction ⟷ structure (the scalar before the array)

Tutorial_Row.anti: the buffer lanes you can see but not enter
Tutorial_Row.tension: order ⟷ the axis privileged, all else held as context

Tutorial_2D_Build.anti: the grid agent — the first thing that navigates

Tutorial_3D.anti: the body ascending the Z-index with its legs
Tutorial_3D.tension: the array as abstraction ⟷ the array as a room you inhabit

Tutorial_Pattern.anti: the eye that solves the pattern before the mind derives it
Tutorial_Pattern.tension: the machine derives from rule ⟷ the human perceives the rule

Tutorial_Disco.hero: the 17×17 dance floor — the array as environment
Tutorial_Disco.anti: the step sequencer — time entering the grid
Tutorial_Disco.tension: spatial ⟷ spatiotemporal (getting lost in a data structure)

SoftBodies_Soft_Body_Deformation.hero: the jelly cube — matter at λ=0.5
SoftBodies_Soft_Body_Deformation.anti: the rigid solid it refutes (Primitives' trustworthy cube)
SoftBodies_Soft_Body_Deformation.tension: form as a static property ⟷ form as a dynamic equilibrium

SoftBodies_Carusell.hero: the soft body as distributed instrument
SoftBodies_Carusell.anti: the rigid pendulum that hides the force gradient
SoftBodies_Carusell.tension: a force reported as one number ⟷ a force read across a whole surface

SoftBodies_Obsticals.anti: the breathing walls — the environment that keeps changing
SoftBodies_Obsticals.tension: collision as instant resolution ⟷ collision as negotiation over time (who yields?)

SoftBodies_Cloth_Physics.anti: the identical mass points (silk or rubber by wiring alone)
SoftBodies_Cloth_Physics.tension: material as physical ⟷ material as topological (relations, not elements)

SoftBodies_Playground_of_Joy.hero: free play — haptic intuition before formal understanding
SoftBodies_Playground_of_Joy.anti: the branching growth algorithm — growth = deformation at another timescale
SoftBodies_Playground_of_Joy.tension: physics ⟷ biology (the pivot the map hides)

SoftBodies_Affect_Theory_Visualization.hero: the radiolarian — form the material grew, no designer
SoftBodies_Affect_Theory_Visualization.anti: Haeckel's gaze — beauty seen in a thing with no concept of it
SoftBodies_Affect_Theory_Visualization.tension: simulation technique ⟷ ontology (softness = the capacity to be affected)

ProceduralGeneration_Reaction_Diffusion_.hero: two chemicals — the leopard computing its spots
ProceduralGeneration_Reaction_Diffusion_.anti: the blueprint that pattern doesn't need
ProceduralGeneration_Reaction_Diffusion_.tension: form designed ⟷ form computed by matter (Turing's tender last gift)

Topology_Entropy_Morphogenesis.anti: the odd cycle — the local impossibility
Topology_Entropy_Morphogenesis.tension: solve on its own terms ⟷ resolve by changing the level (blossom contraction)

Chamber_SoftBodies.tension: rigidity as fact ⟷ rigidity as a design choice (who pushed whom?)
